title: qontinui-studio import manifest
description: <inbox-dir>/manifest.yaml for `studio library import <inbox-dir>`. A list of entries, one per image file. The studio validates the WHOLE manifest before writing anything: one invalid entry refuses the import, and every problem is reported with its entry index. The YAML is read with YAML 1.2 scalars: only true/false are booleans (`yes`/`no` are strings) and dates are strings. Width, height, SHA-256 and MIME type are measured from the file, never read from the manifest. Rules this schema cannot express, enforced by the studio: `file` must resolve to a regular file inside the inbox (no symlinks) that Pillow decodes as PNG, JPEG or WebP; a string in `reference_images` must be an asset_id already in the library (or elsewhere in this manifest) and not the entry's own; `commercial_use: yes` without `tos_reviewed` is recorded as `unknown` (warning); `status: approved|rejected` without both `approved_by` and `approved_on` is recorded as `candidate` (warning); `status: approved` is refused unless the recorded commercial_use is `yes` (D5); the same file bytes twice under one asset_id in one manifest is refused.

alias.description: An operator alias, never an e-mail address and never containing whitespace.

file.description: Path of the image relative to the inbox directory. Absolute paths, '..' components and symlinks are refused. The file is copied into the library; the inbox is never referenced after import.

asset_id.description: The library asset id. Several files may share one asset_id; each becomes its own row. Re-importing the same bytes under the same asset_id is a no-op.

account.description: ALIAS of the provider account used (never the address).

reference_images.description: Images the generation was conditioned on. Bare local paths are refused.

oneOf.description: An asset_id already in this library.

licence_terms_url.description: The provider's terms that govern this image.

tos_reviewed.description: The date those terms were reviewed. Required for commercial_use: yes to be recorded as yes.

commercial_use.description: Whether the terms allow commercial use.

ai_generated.description: Must be true: the library holds AI-generated assets only.

status.description: Approval state. Approval is library metadata for consumers, not a publish gate.

approved_by.description: Alias of who approved (or rejected) the image.
